Details Product Quick Look Also known as a "moka pot", this Limited Puerto Rican Artists Edition "Greca" (as commonly known in Puerto Rico) is a stove-top espresso coffee maker that brews coffee by passing boiling water pressurized by steam through your favorite ground coffee. This limited edition collectors item piece is distinguished by the artists beautiful art work and signature. Ancadez's rendition features birds on a line on one side and the Puerto Rico Flag Star on the other. Joshua Montes takes advantage of Puerto Rico's natural beauty and features the "Coqui" (Puerto Rico's endemic tree frog) and the Maga Flower, which happens to be the island's emblematic flower. No matter which you choose, you really can't go wrong. Makes approximately 6 espresso cups. Limited Puerto Rican Artists Edition Stovetop Espresso Coffee Maker Your purchase helps support the work of local Puerto Rican Artists: Ancadez and Joshua Montes Made of Durable Aluminum Makes Approximately 6 Espresso Cups Includes a 4oz Cafe Oro Sample so you can Brew your first Cup as Soon as you Receive your Purchase!
